name: Message
purpose: One turn: user, assistant, system or tool; streaming, error and stopped states; copy, regenerate, edit, branches.
description: One turn in a conversation. The role sets the layout: user messages are right-aligned bubbles on `bg-tertiary`; assistant and tool messages flow full-width next to an avatar; system messages are a centred line between hairlines. Every message is an `<article>` named by its speaker, so it is always clear who said what. Part of the Agent kit.

role.notes: Figma: Role — who is speaking. Sets layout, label and default name.

status.notes: Figma: Status — `streaming` keeps the message busy; `error` and `stopped` show an inline notice.

name.notes: Figma: Name — the speaker ("You", "Atomus AI", "Research agent"). Always announced to screen readers.

avatar.notes: Figma: Avatar — an Avatar or logo; assistants default to the AI mark.

showName.notes: Figma: Show name — show the speaker name visually (screen readers always get it). Defaults to true except for user messages.

aiLabel.notes: Figma: AI label — shows the AI label next to an assistant's name.

copyText.notes: Plain text of the message for the Copy action; Copy is hidden without it.

onRegenerate.notes: Figma: Regenerate — assistant messages; also the retry action for `status="error"`.

branch.notes: Figma: Branch — ‹ 1/3 › switcher between regenerated or edited versions

actions.notes: Extra actions after the built-in ones (e.g. Feedback)

actionsVisibility.notes: Figma: Actions visibility — `always`, or on `hover` and keyboard focus (always shown on touch screens)

errorMessage.default: Something went wrong while generating this response.

do: Name every speaker; use the product's assistant name rather than "AI".
Keep the order of what happened: reasoning, then tools, then approvals, then the answer.
Show actions on hover only in dense threads; they stay visible on touch screens and on focus.
Keep the latest assistant message's actions visible.
forbidden: Never style assistant text as a bubble that looks like a person's message.
Never remove the speaker name from the accessible name.
Never show Regenerate on a user message or Edit on an assistant message.
Never hide an error behind a toast — keep it in the message with a Retry.
